research_result.description: Vonage provides a suite of APIs for messaging, voice, video, verification, and unified communications, allowing developers to integrate multi-channel communication capabilities into applications.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free Vonage account without a credit card to obtain an API key and secret, receive trial credits, and create applications in the Developer Dashboard or CLI to generate private keys for JWT authentication.

evidence.claim: Vonage offers REST APIs described using OpenAPI specification version 3.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: OpenAPI is an industry standard specification for describing APIs. We use OpenAPI to describe all our APIs, and we make those specifications publicly available too.

evidence.claim: Vonage Verify v2 API provides REST endpoints for verification workflows.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Verify API provides a choice of routes for sending a code to a user.

evidence.claim: Vonage APIs support authentication via API Key and Secret, Basic Authentication, and JSON Web Tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: When you create a Vonage account, an API key and secret will be created for you.

evidence.claim: Vonage Business Communications APIs use OAuth for authentication.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Vonage Business Communications APIs use OAuth for authentication.

evidence.claim: Developers can create a Vonage account for free without requiring a credit card.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 1. A Vonage account - Sign up for free if you don't have one yet

evidence.claim: Vonage provides official MCP servers including a Documentation MCP Server and a Server API Bindings MCP Server.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Vonage provides a few different individual MCP implementations, based on your needs.
